jobs.occupation: Veterinary Product Specialist - Pharma & Vaccines Poultry
jobs.description:
Our client is a global veterinary health company specialized in the research, development, production, and marketing of pharmaceutical products and vaccines for companion animals and livestock market. With a presence in 50 countries, our client is recognized as one of the top animal health companies worldwide. 

Jobomschrijving

As a successful Veterinary Product Specialist - Pharma & Vaccines Poultry - Benelux, you have the following responsibilities:

Veterinary Service Manager: 

• Serve as the technical expert for animal health products (pharma & vaccines) for poultry 
• Provide scientific and technical support to veterinarians, farmers, and distributors across the Benelux region.
• Conduct training sessions, seminars, round tables and product demonstrations for veterinarians, farmers and distributors across the Benelux region.
• Develop your network of Key Opinion Leader (KOLs) within the poultry sector in the Benelux region. 
• Support the launch of new products by highlighting the technical & scientific benefits of the new products. 

Internal Collaboration:

• Work closely with the Sales teams to enhance customer engagement for Poultry products.
• Collaborate with the marketing team in the BENEDACH by providing technical & scientific advice on the creation of marketing support.

Market analysis & awareness: 

• Organize and participate to events and congresses to develop your network within the animal health industry and the expand the pharma, medicines and vaccines visibility within the Poultry sector.
• Represent the company at conferences, trade shows, and professional events.
• Monitor industry trends, competitor activities, and emerging health challenges.
• Ensure compliance with industry regulations and company policies.

As a successful Veterinary Product Specialist - Pharma & Vaccines Poultry - Benelux, you have the following profile:

• Doctor of Veterinary Medicine (DVM) degree, Master Degree in Agriculture or equivalent.
• Experience / Knowledge in Poultry is mandatory. 
• You are autonomous with the willingness to travel in the Benelux region. 
• Ability to translate complex scientific information into practical guidance.
• Fluent in Dutch & English with a intermediate knowledge of French.

Our client supports businesses with mobility management and operational solutions within the financial services sector. They focus on efficiency, flexibility, and strong client relationships. They also adapt quickly to evolving needs in their industry.

Jobomschrijving

• Act as a trusted financial partner to business and operational teams
• Support strategic decisions through financial analysis and scenario modelling
• Lead financial input for business cases, investments, pricing, and negotiations
• Drive budgeting, forecasting, and mid-term planning processes
• Deliver accurate variance analysis with clear insights on risks and opportunities
• Ensure cost control and alignment of resources with business strategy
• Define, track, and analyse KPIs linked to strategic objectives
• Build and improve dashboards and reporting for transparency and accountability
• Continuously enhance financial processes and data quality
• Collaborate with Accounting, Procurement, Sales, and Operations
• Ensure consistency and reliability of financial information
• Represent Finance in cross-functional projects and transformation initiatives 

• Master's degree in Finance/Economics and 7-10 years' experience in Controlling or FP&A (international exposure preferred)
• Strong expertise in financial planning, reporting, and closing (P&L & Balance Sheet)
• Advanced analytical and modelling skills (Excel, BI tools)
• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills; fluent in English (FR/NL a plus)
• Business-oriented mindset with strong ownership, attention to detail, and ability to drive change in dynamic environments

Our client is an international B2B organization operating across multiple countries and known for delivering tailored solutions to corporate customers. In Belgium, the company employs over 100 professionals across two offices and provides a wide range of specialized services. 

For its IT department based in Brussels, our client is looking for a Data Automation Analyst to strengthen the Project Management team.

Jobomschrijving

Our client is an international B2B organization operating across multiple countries and known for delivering tailored solutions to corporate customers. In Belgium, the company employs over 100 professionals across two offices and provides a wide range of specialized services. 

For its IT department based in Brussels, our client is looking for a Data Automation Analyst to strengthen the Project Management team.

The mission of the team is simple: to make everyone's work within the organization easier and more meaningful through process automation and optimization. In this role, you develop and maintain business applications, data-driven solutions, and automated workflows that make our operational processes more efficient, reliable, and scalable.

• You design solutions that:
• process data,
• automate processes,
• support users,
• and intelligently connect different systems.

You work closely with internal stakeholders, IT colleagues, and international teams.

Your responsibilities:

• Develop Python scripts, tools, and automations for data processing, reporting, and operational efficiency
• Build solutions on the Microsoft Power Platform (Power Apps, Power Automate, Dataverse)
• Develop, manage, and enhance internal applications
• Analyze manual processes and transform them into sustainable digital workflows
• Integrate applications and data sources within the Microsoft ecosystem, particularly through APIs
• Gather business requirements and propose innovative, tailored solutions
• Develop tools and reports while proactively suggesting improvements to save time and increase process reliability
• Lead development projects related to automation
• Ensure documentation, testing, maintenance, and continuous improvement of solutions
• Contribute to discussions on architecture, governance, security, and future technology choices
• Collaborate with teams in Belgium, at headquarters, and across other entities to deploy solutions The diversity of assignments and stakeholders makes this position dynamic, varied, and rich in development opportunities.

You have a Data Automation Analyst profile or are generally very comfortable with data and automation. You combine accuracy with a strong analytical mindset, which is essential given the complexity and volume of data. 
In a nutshell:

• Degree in Computer Science or a related field
• Technical skills: Linux, Python, SQL, Power Apps, Power Automate
• Additional assets: Linux Shell, PowerShell, Git, Snowflake, Power BI, computer networking, API integrations, CI/CD, or deployment experience
• Soft skills: Attention to detail, analytical thinking, ability to explain complex information in simple terms, strong communication skills, autonomy, and initiative
• Experience: Minimum 2 years (industry experience is not important)
• Good command of Dutch and excellent English communication skills. French would be an advantage but is not required.

For one of our clients, which is NOT active in the insurance sector, we are looking for a Junior Insurance Officer. 

The company is based next to a metro station in Brussels, early reachable by public transport.

You will join a very modern and international environment.

Jobomschrijving

This Insurance Officer mission is open for a junior freelancer, or an employee starting by a fixed term contract, with a possibility of permanent contract after a few months.

You will be responsible, among others, of :

• Claims Management: Registration of new claims, defining whether a claim should be reported, adding in the CRM, monitoring claims with project managers, experts, and brokers.
• Administration of Insurance Policies: Reviewing newly issued policies, checking whether project policies need to be extended, verifying related endorsements, and ensuring overall policy compliance.
• CRM Monitoring and New Project Analysis: Reviewing newly entered projects, verifying project durations, monitoring project completion, enabling transition when there is a maintenance period, and ensuring data accuracy.
• Workers' Compensation Insurance Management: Harmonizing workers' compensation insurance across all entities, reviewing annual audits and statistics, liaising with entities and the broker regarding coverage, coordinating insurance aspects of entity mergers, and related activities.
• Invoicing Follow-up: Verifying the accuracy of invoices issued by the broker, monitoring reminders, and follow-up actions for outstanding invoices.
• Preparation and Management of Liability Policies: Requesting technical information from entities both at project inception and after project completion/acceptance, and regularizing project policies following project handover.

This Insurance Officer mission is open for a junior freelancer, or an employee starting by a fixed term contract, with a possibility of permanent contract after a few months.

• You have at least two years of experience in the insurance industry.
• You are proficient in Dutch, French, and English.
• You are curious and proactive.
• You enjoy working as part of a team.
• You are available immediately or at the latest in September.

Our client, a well-known manufacturer and distributor, is actively looking for a Sales Support Specialist as an extension of the current team.

This company has an international scope and is fast growing. Currently they are looking for a new colleague to expand and support the region.

The company is located in the region of Wilrijk and can easily be reached by car, bike & public transport.

Jobomschrijving

As Sales Support Representative you are responsible for following tasks:

• You will be responsible for the entire order-to-cash process; from order processing and follow-up to shipping, invoicing and after sales
• Configure the most optimal container/truck load 
• Provide support to the Account Managers in your region
• Product & Pricing Management: propose equivalent products to customers, give discounts on the gross price, prepare price lists, ... in consultation with the account managers
• You act as a central point of contact for the distributors in your region
• You are the key figure between the internal organization and the customer. You will have to coordinate on a regular basis with various internal departments (traffic department, production, sales, marketing ...)
• You will work in close contact with production to avoid peaks in the productions and supply chain
• You will be responsible for the shipments (preparations of the needed documents, arrangement of the shipments, follow-up,...)
• Handle Letters of Credit
• Daily customer contact in which you will be responsible for implementing and translating the commercial strategy: upselling / cross-selling, pushing marketing & promo actions, collecting & mapping customer information in the CRM, ...

You will report to the Sales Support Coordinator of your region.

• You have relevant experience in Customer Service positions (order to cash) or you are a motivated junior profile with interest in export
• You speak fluent English and French, knowledge of Dutch is a plus
• You like internal (traffic department, sales, marketing) and external (clients, distributors) contact
• Diplomatic and assertive communication style
• You are a born problem solver
• You are a result oriented team player
• Accurate and stress-resistant

jobs.occupation: CE Driver with a valid Code 95
jobs.description:
Fixed Routes | Early Finish | Meaningful Work
 

Do you enjoy starting your day with a good cup of coffee and heading straight out on the road? Then we have the perfect job for you!
 

For a stable and growing organization in the Oedelem region, we are looking for a CE Driver who values structure, independence, and teamwork.
 

You help ensure that hospitals, healthcare facilities, and holiday parks receive clean linen every day. Essential work with a direct impact.
 

What will you do?
 

 
• As a CE Driver, you are a key part of the logistics process:
 
• You start your shift between 4:00 PM and 8:00 PM with a fully loaded truck.
 
• You drive a fixed route serving customers (6 to 8 stops per trip).
 
• You deliver clean linen and collect used textiles.
 
• You return to the laundry facility for your next route.
 
• Your role consists of approximately 50% driving and 50% loading/unloading.
 
• You work independently while being part of a supportive team where collaboration is highly valued. 

Who are we looking for as a CE Driver?
 

 
• You hold a CE driving licence with a valid Code 95.
 
• You are hands-on and not afraid of physical work.
 
• You are customer-focused, reliable, and flexible.
 
• You speak Dutch and/or English.
 
• You live within 25 minutes of Oedelem.
 
• You are available to work 37.5 hours per week (4 or 5 days).

Do you have experience working in a warehouse or in logistics in general? Then we are looking for you!
 

In this role, you’ll be part of a supportive and collaborative team within an international pharmaceutical production company.
 

As a Warehouse Associate you'll manage the following:
 

 
• You take care of everything that comes in and goes out of the company and ensure that every step is properly documented.
 
• You handle inventory receipts and transactions related to inbound, picking, and outbound operations. 
 
• You receive and inspect biological products in a temperature-controlled environment, ensuring all GMP/GDP procedures are followed. 
 
• You safely handle all materials and ensure they are stored correctly. 
 
• You perform inventory checks to maintain stock accuracy and support order picking and packing activities. 

 
•  
You have experience in logistics or warehouse work.
 
 
•  
You are looking for a long- term job, and you are enthousiastic to learn new skills. 
 
 
•  
You pay attention to detail and like to work accurately.
 
 
•  
You follow procedures carefully to ensure product quality and your own safety.
 
 
•  
You enjoy working in a team and support your colleagues.
 
 
•  
You communicate well in English.
 
 
•  
You can travel to work with your own transportation method.
 
 
•  
You are comfortable using a computer and Microsoft Office.

Job Responsibilities:
 

1. Payable Accounting: - Checking, booking the invoices , the internal & external staff expenses - Monitoring payments via Isabel - Resolving disputes with suppliers (CN,Reminder,...) - Booking financial transactions and carrying out bank reconciliations
 

2. Year end and monthly closing: Help in preparing the Audit file and financial reports
 

3. Support to Finance & Business Controler: - Preparation of annual budgets and periodic forecasts by molecule brand and market segment - Prepare profitability analysis by product - Monitor performance by distribution channel - Manage data from pharma-specific systems - Maintain accuracy in product master data - Maintain Excel dashboards tailored to the commercial business units
 

4. Support to Customer Services: Lettering accounts and monitoring debt collection 5. Working on ad-hoc project

Educational background:
 

Bachelor in Accountancy Languages: French, Dutch and good working knowledge of English
 

IT: Good knowledge in Excell, and knowledge in Microsoft Office (Inter)personal
 

skills: Organizational skills, methodical, structured, team player and reliable Other : Knowledge of Oracle abd the Isabel payment module is a plus.

CONCRETE WORKER – BORNEM – FULLTIME DAILY HOURS
At Manpower, we are looking for a Concrete Worker for a hands-on production environment where you see real results every day. As a Concrete Worker, you work in a fixed team where colleagues know each other and help out. The workplace is a concrete workshop with clear workstations and practical equipment. What makes this Concrete Worker job different? You receive on-the-job training so you can gradually take on more responsibilities.

Jobomschrijving

What does a working day look like as a Concrete Worker? You start at 6 a.m. and finish at 2:30 p.m., together with your team. As a Concrete Worker, your tasks are varied and concrete:

• You help produce precast concrete elements.
• You burn off cables following clear instructions.
• You occasionally operate the overhead crane.
• You carry out pressure tests to check quality.
• You support colleagues where needed and keep your workplace tidy.
As a Concrete Worker, you work closely with fellow workers and a team supervisor. Teamwork is key, and you can always rely on guidance on the floor.

What do we expect from you as a Concrete Worker?

Must-haves

• You can work in a fixed schedule from 6:00 to 14:30.
• You have a good knowledge of English or Dutch to follow instructions.
• You are willing to step in where needed and learn different tasks.
• You can work both independently and in a team.
• You work safely and in an orderly way.
Nice-to-haves

• Experience with concrete or an overhead crane is a plus for a Concrete Worker, but not required.

jobs.description:
Help drivers get back on the road quickly and safely.

About the role: As a Telephone Roadside Assistance Agent, you are the first point of contact for drivers who experience a breakdown while on the road. You remain calm, ask the right questions, and make sure every driver receives the support they need. You coordinate interventions with partner services and keep the driver informed throughout the process. It's a role with real impact: thanks to your composure, communication skills, and problem-solving mindset, you make a genuine difference during stressful moments. Your responsibilities: 

 
•  
 Answer incoming calls from drivers experiencing vehicle breakdowns. 

 
• Assess the situation by asking targeted questions and gathering essential information. 
 
•  
Organise interventions and dispatch assistance to towing services, partners, or technicians. 

 
•  
Follow up each case from start to finish, ensuring clear and proactive communication with the driver. 

 
•  
Record all relevant data in the system (time, location, issue details, planning, updates...). 

 
• Stay calm in urgent situations and consistently act with customer focus. 
 
• Working together in a dedicated team: You will be part of a team that is committed 24/7 to providing our customers with the best possible support.

• Strong communication skills and the ability to speak clearly, empathetically, and professionally over the phone. 
 

 
• Stress resilience and the ability to maintain oversight in busy situations. 
 
•  
A natural talent for problem-solving. 

 
•  
Confidence in working with digital tools and administrative follow-up.
